builds.name: Reference: Engage and rescue
builds.goal: Reference for Thresh: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A catch-and-peel controller who hooks enemies, adjusts spacing with Flay and offers allies a lantern escape while souls grow defenses and AP. Fix soul AP/armor and charged Flay attack state. An attack route must repay losing lantern saves and frontline durability; do not assume every attack gets the fully charged bonus. A support quest and protective actives test allied survival after an engage.
testPlan: Kit question for Thresh: Fix soul AP/armor and charged Flay attack state. An attack route must repay losing lantern saves and frontline durability; do not assume every attack gets the fully charged bonus.

Start with the early core (Support quest, boots and Locket; choose later actives by threat) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use real support income and keep the quest/vision slot.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: A support quest and protective actives test allied survival after an engage. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Thresh binds an enemy in chains and pulls them toward him. Activating this ability a second time pulls Thresh to the enemy. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Low income rarely reaches six items; Mikael does not remove airborne/suppression.

Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility. Also record allies lost while spending on personal damage.
tradeoffs: Low income rarely reaches six items; Mikael does not remove airborne/suppression.
Full cost 10,650 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Support quest, boots and Locket; choose later actives by threat. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Begin with the actual support quest item; Celestial Opposition is earned by transformation, not directly bought as a 400-gold legendary. Keep buying vision.
Knight's Vow, Zeke's Convergence, Mikael's Blessing are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

kitEvidence.formula:
Thresh throws out his scythe, Stunning the first unit hit and Pulling them towards Thresh for [1.5] seconds. The scythe does [100 / 150 / 200 / 250 / 300 + (0.9) × AP] magic damage and also grants True Sight for the duration.

Thresh can Recast this Ability to pull himself to the enemy.

If this Ability hits, its Cooldown is reduced by [2] seconds.

Thresh throws his lantern, allowing an ally to click on it to dash to Thresh.

The lantern also grants [50 / 70 / 90 / 110 / 130 + (2) × BuffStacks({5fbfbf13})] Shield for [4] seconds to Thresh and the first ally champion to come in contact with it.

Passive: Thresh's Attacks deal additional damage based on how long since he last Attacked. They deal between [(1.7) × BuffStacks({5fbfbf13})] and [(1.7) × BuffStacks({5fbfbf13}) + (0.9 / 1.2 / 1.5 / 1.8 / 2.1) × AD] magic damage.

Active: Thresh whips his chains, Pulling or Pushing enemies in the direction of the swing. Enemies hit are also Slowed by [20 / 25 / 30 / 35 / 40]% for [1] second and take [65 / 110 / 155 / 200 / 245 + (0.6) × AP] magic damage.
Thresh collects the Souls of dead enemies by walking near them. Each Soul grants him [1] Armor and [1] Ability Power.

Thresh creates a prison of spectral walls, Slowing champions by [99]% for [2] seconds and dealing [250 / 400 / 550 + (1) × AP] magic damage. Walls break after one collision, and after one is broken, the rest deal no damage and Slow for half duration.
